notes: Item 19 is fully present and well-structured. Two major analyses are disclosed: (1) Gross Sales for all franchised and company-affiliated restaurants open the full fiscal year, broken down by performance thirds (Top, Middle, Bottom) for FY2025 and FY2024; (2) Gross Sales and selected cost information (COGS, Labor, 4-Wall EBITDA) for company-affiliated restaurants only, plus estimated franchisee-specific expenses (royalties, marketing fund, local advertising). OCR artifact noted on page 50: the COGS average dollar amount appears partially obscured ('$A560n498' and '$A490n203' in image), but the text extraction on page 50 shows $774,600 and $772,790 respectively, which are consistent with the earlier table data and narrative; these values were used. The '--7.1%' OCR artifact for lowest 4-Wall EBITDA was interpreted as -7.1%. Royalties, Marketing Fund Contribution, and Local Advertising in the second chart are explicitly labeled 'estimated' (not actual company costs) — they are derived by applying fixed percentage rates (4.5%, 1%, 1%) to the company-affiliated gross sales figures. No Item 19 data is provided for franchised restaurant costs or EBITDA, as the franchisor explicitly states it lacks confidence in franchisee cost data.
